mapper.select: SELECT monitor_sys_gen_server_log_level as level, COUNT(*) as count FROM monitor_sys_gen_server_logs WHERE monitor_sys_gen_server_id = #{serverId} AND monitor_sys_gen_server_log_create_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} AND monitor_sys_gen_server_log_status = 1 GROUP BY monitor_sys_gen_server_log_level

SELECT monitor_sys_gen_server_log_source as source, COUNT(*) as count FROM monitor_sys_gen_server_logs WHERE monitor_sys_gen_server_id = #{serverId} AND monitor_sys_gen_server_log_create_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} AND monitor_sys_gen_server_log_status = 1 GROUP BY monitor_sys_gen_server_log_source

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(monitor_sys_gen_server_log_create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00') as hour, COUNT(*) as count FROM monitor_sys_gen_server_logs WHERE monitor_sys_gen_server_id = #{serverId} AND monitor_sys_gen_server_log_create_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} AND monitor_sys_gen_server_log_status = 1 GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(monitor_sys_gen_server_log_create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00') ORDER BY hour

SELECT COUNT(*) as exceptionCount, COUNT(DISTINCT monitor_sys_gen_server_log_logger) as distinctLoggers FROM monitor_sys_gen_server_logs WHERE monitor_sys_gen_server_id = #{serverId} AND monitor_sys_gen_server_log_exception_stack IS NOT NULL AND monitor_sys_gen_server_log_exception_stack != '' AND monitor_sys_gen_server_log_create_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} AND monitor_sys_gen_server_log_status = 1
